description: This file contains functions and a class for processing and loading Open Images dataset annotations, including hierarchy handling, label mapping, and image annotation generation, as well as a generator class for dataset iteration.

classes.name: OpenImagesGenerator
classes.description: A dataset generator class for Open Images, capable of filtering labels, loading images and annotations, and managing dataset hierarchy.

methods.name: load_hierarchy
methods.description: Loads the hierarchy JSON data for a specified dataset version.

methods.name: load_hierarchy_children
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all child label names from a hierarchy node.

methods.name: find_hierarchy_parent
methods.description: Finds and returns the parent hierarchy node for a given label.

methods.name: get_labels
methods.description: Retrieves label descriptions and indices from dataset metadata files.

methods.name: generate_images_annotations_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON mapping of image IDs to their annotations, including bounding boxes and image sizes.
